name: SBOL Component
description: a designed thing — a plasmid, a part, a strain — described rather than possessed. The design, never the tube
notes: Taken from the SBOL 3 data model, with SBOL's own class and property names — docs/ONTOLOGY.md § Alignment with SBOL. Where this departs from SBOL it says so in this field; silence means it does not depart. Not every SBOL property is modelled yet: what is here is what this lab's work needs, and adding one is adding a field, not a redesign.

types.description: what KIND of thing this is, by ontology term — SBO DNA, protein, cell. Required: a Component with no type is a noun with no category.

roles.description: what it is FOR, by ontology term — promoter, CDS, engineered region. Sequence Ontology in the ordinary case.

sequences.description: references to sbol.sequence records. A reference, not the letters: one sequence may serve many components.

features.description: the parts within it — SubComponents and the like.
